fusions.name: Paddlewash
fusions.desc: Throws water across a cone 2.5 tiles long that deals 4 damage, with a 35% chance to leave each enemy [Soaked] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Skimmed Landing
fusions.desc: A flat sheet of water that deals 12 damage to the first enemy it meets and knocks it back 2 tiles, then skips on to 1 more enemy within 3 tiles for 80% of that.

fusions.name: Beads and Runs Off
fusions.desc: For 6 seconds, each condition laid on you has a 50% chance to land on whoever laid it instead.

fusions.name: Churn Under Calm
fusions.desc: You walk on water and swamp as on solid ground. While you are on water or swamp, from bronze rank you move 10% faster, from silver your stamina recovers 20% faster, and from gold your dodge chance rises by 8%.
